items.q: this constituted the fellas in Fletcher's band, of course. The trombonist, Jimmy Harrison... and I would take Fletcher's book up.

ctx.x: Why don't you tell us a little bit about that? We did talk about it before, but --

Yes, well, Coleman Hawkins had an apartment in New York City, what they call up on Sugar Hill, 80 St. Nicholas Place. I'll never forget it. And we used to go up and have jam sessions at his apartment, after they finished playing the Roseland, and this constituted the fellas in Fletcher's band, of course. The trombonist, Jimmy Harrison; Buster Bailey, the clarinetist; and Coleman Hawkins, of course; and Louis Armstrong; and the trombonist Big Green; and they would sit down and call out the standard tunes to play,…
